name: BACH_0069
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (93%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Unflagged tier-4 case with a single-class conformal set and 0% invasive risk [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 93%, InSitu 4%, Normal 3%, Invasive 0% | Strong benign score; zero invasive |
| Conformal set | Benign (α=0.1, 90% coverage) | Single class at 90% coverage |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 94th OOD percentile [F6] | Passes QC; atypical versus training |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree (true) | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 20% (1/5 Benign, 3 Normal, 1 InSitu) [F5] | Weak match; neighbors mostly Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 1, 8, 11) · context · Above-typical (2.03), contribution -1.55 [F2] · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 3) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical (-0.19), contribution -0.70 [F3] · Validated
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 8) · ↓ invasive · Score 1.06 (-0.32), 0/20 spot-check [F4] · Unreliable
- **HoVer-Net nuclei** (regions 5, 6, 11) · context · 88th-percentile inflammatory (6%), 86th-percentile neoplastic (1385/mm²) · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful on deletion test (top-3 risk removal beats random: +0.0114, CI 0.0021–0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); uses Unreliable normal lobules (0/20), mitoses (0/20), necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Dense lymphocytes (regions 1, 8, 11) and 94th-percentile OOD appearance mask InSitu (4%).
- High HoVer-Net neoplastic-labeled density (86th percentile, regions 5, 6, 11) reflects true atypia.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 5, 6**: Check highest-risk tiles (0.003, 0.001) with 68–75 neoplastic-labeled nuclei and pleomorphism.
2. **Regions 1, 8, 11**: Verify benign lobules and dense lymphocytes (28 inflammatory cells in 11).
3. **Regions 2, 3**: Confirm benign tubules and duct-confined epithelium without in situ carcinoma.
